title: Business tools
summary: On the Você tab of a company account, a section lists the business tools: Agenda, Catálogo, Pedidos, Orçamentos and Fila virtual. Each row opens its owner screen.

isCompany.description: Shown only for a company account (ADR 0132 account type).

agendaPublished.description: Subtitle bipe_agenda_published or bipe_agenda_not_published, or bipe_agenda_activate before activation.
